entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, um, Isaac? I need to... I think I need to return something. I'm just so confused by the website. I have a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, yes, I think so. It's VF... 8... 6... 7... 5... 3... 0... 9. I got it about a month ago, I think.

Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. So I can understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, it just... it wasn't for me. But the problem is, I tried to return it weeks ago. I went on the website but there must have been some kind of website error. Nothing was working.
I see. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return online?

I tried to start the return, but the whole system seemed to be down. The page just kept loading and loading, and I absolutely couldn't print the label. I got so frustrated. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I didn't know what else to do. Can't you just help me? I don't understand these things.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the trouble with our site. Let me check our system logs for that period. ... Yes, it looks like we did have a known service outage that affected our returns portal about three weeks ago. Thank you for bringing that to my attention and for your patience.
Oh, so it wasn't just me? I thought I was going crazy.
Not at all, that was definitely our fault. Now, let me just review the return eligibility for your item... Okay, looking here, it says VeloFit products can be returned within 90 days of delivery.
Yes, and since your order was delivered 32 days ago, you are well within that window. The website issue is noted, but you don't even need an exception. I can approve this return for you right now.
Wow, that's... that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm sending the return shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. You should see a full refund within 5-7 business days after we receive it. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
